title: Full C. elegans → full MaleCNS HIVE experiment

architecture.semantics: tag order is execution order; repeated tags repeat calls; removed tags remove components

invariants: The full MaleCNS graph is the primary Bee substrate and may not be replaced by a subgraph in the primary experiment.
The full Cook C. elegans connectome is the primary Larva substrate.
A downloaded dataset does not count as executed.
A subgraph, synthetic reservoir, shuffled graph, no-connectome path, Larva-only path, or Bee-only path is a control/ablation only.
Primary experiment readiness requires both full primary substrates installed, verified, and actually executed by their declared engines.
JEV and LLM are independent toggles; changing either must not change substrate, data environment, task, prompt, or evaluation case.
No silent fallback may satisfy a requested experimental stage.
Inference output is not external action authority.
The Core architecture is an ordered executable tag sequence; runtime, plan API, GUI, traces, and evaluation must resolve the same order.
Matched ablations must preserve the same integration-cycle count unless cycle count itself is the declared experimental variable.
JEV/LLM calls require a fresh readout after the most recent neural or bridge change.
promotion_gates: Implement a full MaleCNS engine that imports and propagates the complete pinned MaleCNS v1.0 graph.
Verify full dataset hashes before import.
Report observed node/connection counts from the loaded graph and fail on mismatch.
Run the same fixed evaluation cases across JEV/LLM toggle states without changing neural substrate.
Keep the locomotor subgraph labeled as a control in setup, API, GUI, docs, and receipts.
Pass software, replay, null/shuffle, and transition tests before declaring the primary experiment ready.
